name: Feedough

sources.title: Submit Your Startup — questionnaire for the Startup Discovery review
Startup Discovery section — states reviews are a paid premium service
Editorial standards — describes the Startup Discovery review process
Partnership/media kit page — startup reviews as an ad product

requirements: Startup Discovery reviews are a paid service: 'this is a premium service and we charge for it' per the section's own disclaimer
Selective even when paid: startup must be 'disruptive', with genuine value and innovation — they reserve the right to reject
Review articles are custom-written by Feedough's team and promoted via email, social and push notifications
preparation: Answers for the submission questionnaire at /submit-your-startup/ (company story, product, traction)
Evidence the venture is disruptive/innovative — that's the stated bar
Budget for the review fee (amount not public)
workflow: Fill in the questionnaire describing your startup and why it's disruptive
Feedough's editorial team evaluates; if accepted they quote pricing
Their team writes the review; it publishes in the Startup Discovery section and is distributed to subscribers/social/push
watchFor: The old '/submit-' batch URL is dead — correct page is /submit-your-startup/
This is pay-for-coverage, not a directory listing; the site discloses it as premium
Rejection is possible even when paying — 'disruptive enough' is the stated filter
Price is not published — expect a quote after questionnaire review
countsAsLive: A review article about the startup published in Feedough's Startup Discovery section
unknowns: Whether links in the review are dofollow
Turnaround time from questionnaire to publication
Whether unpaid/free editorial pitches are ever accepted
